# The Adventures of Sadukie

> 100% me, unapologetically. Sadukie (Sarah Dutkiewicz) is a software architect, tech educator, and community advocate writing about software development, AI, user experience, careers, and building inclusive tech communities.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://sadukie.com/): The Adventures of Sadukie
- [About Me](https://sadukie.com/about-me/): Background, FAQs, and what Sadukie stands for
- [Blog](https://sadukie.com/blog.html): All posts
- [Course Development](https://sadukie.com/course-development.html): Courses and training
- [In the Community](https://sadukie.com/in-the-community.html): Talks, podcasts, and community work
- [Recommended Reading](https://sadukie.com/recommended-reading.html): Books and resources
- [Feed](https://sadukie.com/feed.xml): Atom feed
- [Sitemap](https://sadukie.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap
